summary: Melar Acquisition Corp. I filed an 8-K reporting the issuance of a $1.5M promissory note to its sponsor, Melar Acquisition Sponsor I LLC, for working capital advances. The note bears 17.5% interest, matures upon business combination or liquidation, and permits conversion of up to $1.5M unpaid principal into warrants at $1.00 per warrant, identical to those issued in its IPO. This is a typical SPAC working capital bridge loan to fund operations until a de-SPAC transaction. The filing is exempt under Section 4(a)(2). However, the note itself is not a definitive agreement for a business combination; the sole event is the SPAC's financing. Therefore, this filing does not represent a special situation on its own.
